title: Octave Filter Bank
text: Octave-band and fractional octave-band filter bank, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Bandwidth (octaves)} sets Bandwidth of filters specified in; {Frequency range (Hz)} sets the frequency range of filter bank, {Reference frequency (Hz)} sets the reference frequency of filter bank, {Filter order} sets the order of octave filters, {Octave ratio} sets the distance between filters Base ten, {Inherit sample rate from input} allows sample rate to be set by input, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {Bands as separate output ports} sets the one output port per filter band, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {View filter response} sets the open plot to visualize magnitude response, {Variable name}, {Overwrite variable if it already exists} and {Export filter to workspace} sets the export filter bank. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Bandwidth (octaves)
params.values: Bandwidth of filters specified in octaves 1 octave (default) | 2/3 octave | 1/2 octave | 1/3 octave | 1/6 octave | 1/12 octave | 1/24 octave | 1/48 octave

params.name: Frequency range (Hz)
params.values: Frequency range of filter bank (Hz) [22 22050] (default) | two-element row vector of positive monotonically increasing values

params.name: Reference frequency (Hz)
params.values: Reference frequency of filter bank (Hz) 1000 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Filter order
params.values: Order of octave filters 12 (default) | positive even integer

params.name: Octave ratio
params.values: Distance between filters Base ten (ANSI S1.11 preferred) (default) | Base two (musical scale)

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Allow sample rate to be set by input signal off (default) | on

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Bands as separate output ports
params.values: One output port per filter band off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: View filter response
params.values: Open plot to visualize magnitude response button

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Variable name of exported filter bank myFilt (default) | valid variable name

params.name: Overwrite variable if it already exists
params.values: Overwrite variable if it already exists on (default) | off

params.name: Export filter to workspace
params.values: Export filter bank to workspace button
